newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cultus enters deal with Shell, Todd.
newsitem.headline: Cultus enters deal with Shell, Todd.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum No Liability said on Friday it had entered into an agreement with Shell Petroleum Mining And Todd Petroleum Mining of New Zealand, whereby Shell and Todd will farm into offshore Petroleum Exploration Permit PEP38413 in the Taranaki Basin.
An appraisal well is planned to be drilled 1998 in the Maari prospect which was proven oil bearing by the Moki-1 well in 1983.

Interests in the permit will initially be Cultus 50 percent, Shell 35 percent and Todd 15 percent, with Shell Todd being granted an option to increase their combined interest by a further 20 percent after the drilling of the well.
